text:
Anna P (partnerships): Quick heads-up — kickstarting the cloud catalog ingestion for AWS/GCP/Azure. I uploaded an inventory CSV to the partnerships folder. Need SKU mapping, legal copy check, and pricing tiers.
Sam L (legal): Thanks Anna. Can you paste the top 3 rows here? easier to eyeball before i pull the doc.
Anna P (partnerships): Sure — sample below:
```
sku,product_name,offer_type,price_tier,regions,privacy_notes
RI-DED-GPU-01,Redwood Dedicated GPU Pool,Subscription,commit-1,us-west-2|eu-west-1,customer-data-in-region
RI-HOST-STD,Redwood Hosted API,Usage,consumption,global,redwood-logs-only
```
Jordan K (product): For the Hosted API we should have a separate "trial" SKU or a tier flag for free credits. also need short marketing blurb per SKU (max 120 chars). I'll draft. :+1:
Maria G (eng): One technical note — AWS listing requires AMI id / ingestion metadata for private offer. we don't have a finalized AMI yet for Dedicated. tagging so @Anna P.
Anna P (partnerships): Ack. Maria — timeline for AMI?
Maria G (eng): ETA 2 weeks for the hardened AMI build and tests. can push a placeholder AMI in the catalog to keep the flow but mark as "staging".
Sam L (legal): On legal side, need the following per SKU: (1) export classification, (2) data processing blurb, (3) indemnity flags. I can provide templates but need product copy to slot in.
Raj S (finance): Also confirm how price_tier maps to billing metadata for marketplaces — we support flat monthly + overage. I can send mapping table.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: GCP Publisher onboarding checklist item 3 (billing contact) is missing for this vendor. https://cloud.google.com/marketplace/publishers
Anna P (partnerships): I'll add finance & billing contacts. Jordan — can you draft the 120-char blurb per SKU and drop here by EOD? Sam I'll ping you when that's in.
Jordan K (product): Will do. Drafting now; will post 3 variants for review in ~3h.
Sam L (legal): Once we have the blurb and the AMI placeholders, i'll run the legal text and flag any red lines for marketplace contracts (esp. Azure publisher terms).
Maria G (eng): For Azure there's also the offer listing manifest (JSON) we need to validate. I'll create a skeleton and share. small snippet: 
```
{"offerId":"redwood-dedicated","plans":[{"planId":"p1","sku":"RI-DED-GPU-01"}]}
```
Anna P (partnerships): Nice. Let's avoid publishing anything to prod listings until legal signs off. Short-term plan: use staging manifests and placeholder AMIs so engineering can continue.
Raj S (finance): Noted. Also, billing reconciliation: please include internal SKU code so we can map marketplace payouts to our ledger (field: internal_sku).
Jordan K (product): Added internal_sku column to the CSV and updated sample. sharing updated file link: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/cloud-catalog/inventory.csv
Anna P (partnerships): Great. Next sync: Friday 11am PT to sign off AMI placeholder, legal copy, and pricing tiers. I'll send calendar invite. :calendar:
Sam L (legal): I'll be there. if anything pops up before then i'll ping this thread.
Maria G (eng): I'll bring the manifest template.
marketplace-bot: Note: AWS Marketplace certification window opens in 5 business days for new offers.
Anna P (partnerships): Thanks bot. Team — if you can't make Friday, reply here with availability. Otherwise i'll assume OK and move forward with staging assets. :rocket:
